idioms.meaning_en: Noun the phrase does not imply any coercion, but simply means “a woman who stays at home,” the expression in fact taking on connotations of honor and dignity, for, in Arabia, it was the maids who left the house in order to do outside chores and run errands, while their mistresses stayed at home.
